name: ASSASSIN SPIDER
originalText:
#### ASSASSIN SPIDER

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Do We Not Die
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Area A cube, 1/2 yard on a side, resting on a ﬂat surface
and originating from a point you can reach
Duration 8 hours
You concentrate for 1 hour, during which time you create a
mechanical spider in the area. The spider functions as a tiny
construct with the climber and poisonous traits (see Shadow,
page 263) and makes Agility challenge rolls to hide or sneak
with 3 boons. When the spider appears, you can give it
instructions that it follows until the spell ends: seek out and
attack a particular target, guard an area, or anything else you
like. The spider obeys the letter of your instructions. If sent to
attack a particular creature, you must give the spider a bit of
hair, nail, skin, or scrap of clothing from the creature so it can
track down the proper target.
```

name: CONTAMINATE WATER
originalText:
#### CONTAMINATE WATER

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Do We Not Die
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Area A sphere with a 3-yard radius centered on a point
within your space
All liquids, including those worn or carried by other creatures
(but not those inside creatures), in the area become
poisonous to anyone who consumes them as if those liquids
were mild poison (see “Poisons and Venoms”). The liquids do
not have any effect if injected.
Sacriﬁce You expend a casting of this spell to cast the produce water
spell from the Water tradition.
```

name: CURSE OF THE EMERALD HAND
originalText:
#### CURSE OF THE EMERALD HAND

- **Type:** Attack
- **Source:** Do We Not Die
- **Source Page:** 5

```text
Target One creature within medium range
Make an Intellect attack roll against the target’s Strength. On
a success, the target becomes cursed for 1 hour. While cursed
in this way, the target is poisoned. As well, whenever another
creature makes bodily contact with the target, that creature
must get a success on a Strength challenge roll with 1 bane or
take 1d6 damage and become poisoned for 1 minute.
Attack Roll 20+ The target is poisoned until it completes
a rest.
```

name: SERPENT TONGUE
originalText:
#### SERPENT TONGUE

- **Type:** Attack
- **Source:** Do We Not Die
- **Source Page:** 5

```text
Duration 1 minute
Your tongue lengthens, forcing itself out of your mouth, and
sprouts two barbs from the end that drip poison. Make an
Intellect attack roll against the Agility of one target creature
you can reach. On a success, your tongue barbs strike the
target, dealing 1d3 + 2 damage. The target must then get
a success on a Strength challenge roll or take 1d6 damage
from the poison and become poisoned for 1 minute. If already
poisoned, the target takes 1d6 extra damage.
You cannot talk until the spell ends, but you can repeat the
attack using an action on each of your turns.
Attack Roll 20+ The target takes 1d6 extra damage.
```

name: SPECTACULAR EXPULSION
originalText:
#### SPECTACULAR EXPULSION

- **Type:** Attack
- **Source:** Do We Not Die
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Target Up to three creatures within short range
Intense nausea strikes the targets. Each must make a
Strength challenge roll with 1 bane; a target with Health 20
or less automatically gets a failure. On a failure, the target
becomes dazed for 1 round and takes 2d6 damage as it
spews corrosive vomit into a 3-yard-long cone originating
from its mouth in a randomly determined direction. The acid
deals 3d6 damage to everything in the area. Creatures in
the area can make an Agility challenge roll, taking half the
damage on a success.
```
